# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Program Claim-Layer Sequence

Status: **Stage A lifecycle boundary; no downstream layer is authorized**

The required program sequence is:

```text
candidate-neutral scientific framework
  -> separately authorized quarantined method development
  -> frozen held-out qualification
  -> scientific-owner-approved qualified-method record
  -> sealed implementation-blind author packet
  -> method-specific Stage B authorship
  -> scientific-owner acceptance and freeze
  -> implementation conformity
  -> empirical/observational validation and achieved performance
  -> readiness
  -> production authorization
```

Each arrow is a separate claim and gate. A qualification result does not
automatically supply a scientific contract, implementation conformity,
empirical/observational validation, achieved performance, readiness,
production authority, or operational fallback. A qualified-method record may
enter a sealed implementation-blind author packet only after separate owner
approval and sanitization. Stage B then authors the method-specific science; it
does not inherit authority from prototype code or raw empirical history.

The present package occupies only the first, candidate-neutral Stage A layer.
It creates no lane, packet, contract, implementation, validation, readiness,
or production action.
